data.long_meaning: The name Amritpal is recorded with the meaning “Nectar of the Universe”. Amritpal is a Hindu name meaning “Nectar of the Universe”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. in_sanskrit.name: अमृतपाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who holds or protects the nectar of immortality (Amrit)

in_hindi.name: अमृतपाल
in_hindi.long_meaning: व्यक्त जीवन के लिए अमृत रखने वाला

in_marathi.name: Amritpal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Nectar of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amritpal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amrit (Nectar) + Pal (Protector): The one who protects and bestows the nectar of the universe.

in_bengali.name: Amritpal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Nectar of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Amritpal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Amrit (Nectar) + Pal (Protector): The one who protects and bestows the nectar of the universe.
